What happens next.

Before you request a proposal.

What should we have ready?

The number of units, your current budget, the declaration and bylaws, and your current management agreement if you have one. None of it is required to start the conversation; it helps us quote accurately.

How is the fee set?

A flat monthly fee based on the size of the association and the scope of service, starting at $20 per unit per month. It is never a percentage of your budget. See pricing.

How long does a switch take?

Most transitions run 30 to 60 days after notice to your current manager. See how to switch management companies.

Strong Communities. Our Focus.

Condominium, HOA, and townhome association management for Chicago and the surrounding suburbs.
